property.name: content
property.description:
The connection profile dbt reads, as a template. Ambari renders it with the values from dbt-env and writes the result to profiles.yml every time the service is configured, so this file is the one place to change how dbt connects.
The default covers the warehouses the package has adapters for and that a stack commonly runs: Trino, Spark or Hive over thrift, Impala and PostgreSQL. Every other adapter in the package — oracle, snowflake, bigquery, redshift, databricks, duckdb, athena, sqlserver, teradata, clickhouse — is reached by editing this template, which is why it is a template and not a fixed file.
